financial_base.basis: Core operating EPS TTM through Q3-2026, derived from TTM operating income $157.0B less estimated interest and taxes, divided by ~12,088M diluted shares; FY2025 GAAP diluted EPS $10.81 (clean, excludes 2026 non-operating gains) confirms the ~$10.5 level
financial_base.period: TTM through Q3-2026 (ended Sep 30, 2026), cross-checked vs FY2025 GAAP diluted EPS $10.81
financial_base.normalization_note: GAAP TTM diluted EPS $19.16 is distorted by +$126.8B non-operating investment gains in OI&E (9M-2026), making the headline P/E (~14.6x) misleading and unusable. Core basis: TTM operating income $157.0B (sec-api.io analysis of SEC filings), less ~$3.9B annualized interest on $126.1B total debt, taxed at ~19% effective rate, less ~$0.5B preferred dividends, divided by ~12,088M diluted shares = ~$10.2-10.5/core EPS. Used $10.50 as a conservative normalized core EPS base; the operating business has likely grown since FY2025 ($10.81 GAAP diluted EPS), so this base is conservative. Buybacks were $0 in 9M-2026, so no buyback uplift is assumed.
